items.name: features-anim-001
items.title: Возможности со stagger-появлением
items.description: Полноценная секция возможностей: заголовок по центру и сетка карточек с иконкой, заголовком и описанием. Карточки въезжают по очереди с масштабом и подъёмом, а иконка внутри каждой довешивает лёгкий одноразовый bounce чуть позже.
items.docs: Секция самодостаточна: один файл, ноль зависимостей, палитра в локальных --vibeui-features-anim-001-*. Тему берёт из окружения через light-dark() плюс строку для класса .dark. container-type делает блок собственным query-контейнером: сетка от 34rem становится двухколоночной, от 60rem — трёхколоночной. Иконки нарисованы inline SVG-путями и берут цвет из currentColor. При монтировании карточки въезжают stagger scale+fade по нарастающей задержке на nth-child, а иконка внутри каждой довешивает одноразовый bounce ещё позже. Всё гаснет при prefers-reduced-motion.

en.title: Features with a staggered reveal
en.description: A full features section: a centered heading and a grid of cards with an icon, title and description. Cards rise in one after another with a scale and lift, and the icon inside each adds a light one-off bounce a beat later.
en.docs: The section is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, palette in local --vibeui-features-anim-001-* variables. It takes the theme from the environment via light-dark() plus a rule for the .dark class. container-type makes the block its own query container: the grid becomes two columns from 34rem and three columns from 60rem. Icons are drawn as inline SVG paths on currentColor. On mount, cards rise in with a staggered scale+fade based on nth-child delay, and the icon inside each adds a one-off bounce a bit later. Everything stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

ai.summary: A full-width features section: a centered heading and a grid of up to six icon+title+description cards (two-three columns by width). Cards rise in with a staggered scale+fade, icons add a one-off bounce. Zero dependencies, one file, no client JS.
preserve: the local --vibeui-features-anim-001-* palette — do not swap it for your theme tokens
the staggered scale+fade card reveal and the one-off icon bounce that follows — the section's signature
the inline SVG icons on currentColor instead of an icon library
container-type:inline-size on the root and the two/three-column grid switch by block width
the .dark class rule: without it the section stays light on a dark page in another project
the prefers-reduced-motion rule that disables card and icon animations
adapt: the items content: an icon from the set (bolt/shield/layers/chat/chart/plug), title and description, up to six
the accent color via the accent prop to match your brand
bounce — turns off the one-off icon bounce, keeping only the card entrance
notes: the stagger and bounce timing is wired for the first six cards; extras beyond that appear without delay
bounce={false} only removes the icon animation, cards still enter with scale+fade

props.title: Six reasons to stop hand-coding sections
props.lede: Every feature works on its own — no need to turn them on in sequence.

items.title: Instant install
items.description: One command and the section lands in your project with its styles, no config edits.

items.title: Its own palette
items.description: The section doesn't read your theme and won't break from foreign tokens: colors live inside the file.

items.title: One file
items.description: No sibling components, no utilities: it moves by copy-paste into any project.

items.title: Agent instructions
items.description: Copy for AI ships a list of what must not break and what's safe to change.

items.title: Layout from the block
items.description: Container queries read the section's own width, not the window's: sidebar layouts stay honest.

items.title: Zero dependencies
items.description: No icon packages, no motion libraries — just React and CSS.
